item.title: Nikutai Keiyakusho
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Fulltime
  • 発売日: 2011-12-22
  • スコア: 5.86/10 (19 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 肉体契約書
  • 英語名: Nikutai Keiyakusho

别名

  • Body Contract

あらすじ

You play an agent who scouts potential employees for a very special client. Three beautiful girls come to you desperate for work and willing to do anything to impress you. Take advantage of their vulnerabilities and lead them into decadence and depravity!

This game features a number of gameplay functions to enhance your experience, including realistic animation, selectable groin cam, and full manual control so you can grope, fondle, strip, and screw as you please! Nikutai Keiyakusho also supports T-CAM face tracking technology, which lets the girls look at you, the player. Experience the future of virtual sex.
